heroImageAlt: Rocky coast of Crete bathed in turquoise water
heroIntro: Tailor-made trips, imagined with you and put together only with partners we know.

manifesto.lead: You describe a wish. Our AI concierge gives it a first shape. Then a {{agency}} agent makes it happen, with care and judgement.
manifesto.honestyText: We only offer destinations where our partners are active. If we can't take you there, we'll tell you.

popular.title: Most wanted
popular.intro: Three getaways our travellers often imagine, to reinvent as you like.

elounda.title: Sea-view room, Elounda
elounda.copy: A quiet week by the water, breakfast included.

biarritz.title: Surf lesson, Grande Plage
biarritz.copy: Half a day facing the Atlantic, board included.

marrakech.title: Riad room in the medina
marrakech.copy: A house around a hidden courtyard, 2 nights minimum.

method.intro: Technology to clarify your wishes. People to negotiate, check and take care of the rest.

describe.title: I describe
describe.copy: One sentence is enough. Your words stay with {{agency}}.

refine.title: I refine
refine.copy: A few preferences, only if you want to.

discover.title: I discover
discover.copy: A day-by-day preview, always open to changes.

exchange.title: I talk it over
exchange.copy: I polish it with the concierge, then an advisor takes over.

trust.eyebrow: A real trip, from the first word

realOffers.title: Real offers
realOffers.copy: Every proposal matches an active offer from one of our partners.

noPrice.title: A preview without prices

yourWords.title: Your words, only
yourWords.copy: Never any import of e-mails or social networks. You stay in control.
